results.content:
Based on 36 reviews

Review MindPal ?

Reviewers mostly praise MindPal for making AI workflows easy to build without coding, with strong use cases in research, content, lead qualification, chatbots, and document-based work. Many say it saves significant time, supports complex multi-step workflows, integrates well with existing tools, and ships updates quickly. Some also highlight responsive founders and an active community. But the negatives are serious: several users report broken features, unanswered support, and even an unfulfilled done-for-you service. A founder of Coursekit also notes it powers AI tools they built.
